question: Hány rendelés van az adatbázisban?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders;

question: Hány törölt rendelés van?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE order_status = 'canceled';

question: Mennyi az átlagos termékár?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT AVG(price) FROM order_items;

question: Melyik államból származik a legtöbb vásárló?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT customer_state FROM customers GROUP BY customer_state ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1;

question: Melyik eladó értékesítette a legtöbb terméket?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT seller_id, COUNT(*) AS total_products_sold FROM order_items GROUP BY seller_id ORDER BY total_products_sold DESC LIMIT 1;

question: Melyik termékkategóriából származott a legtöbb eladás?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT COALESCE(pt.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name) AS product_category, COUNT(*) AS total_sales FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id LEFT JOIN product_category_name_translation pt ON p.product_category_name = pt.product_category_name GROUP BY COALESCE(pt.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name) ORDER BY total_sales DESC LIMIT 1;

question: Hány rendelés történt 2017 januárjában?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-01-01' AND order_purchase_timestamp < '2017-02-01';

question: Melyik az 5 legdrágább termék?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT product_id, MAX(price) AS price FROM order_items GROUP BY product_id ORDER BY price DESC LIMIT 5;

question: Melyik vásárló adta le a legtöbb rendelést?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT c.customer_unique_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id ORDER BY order_count DESC LIMIT 1;

question: Melyik termékből származott a legtöbb bevétel?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT p.product_id, SUM(oi.price) AS total_revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.product_id ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 1;

question: Mennyi az összes rendelésben szereplő termékek összértéke?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT SUM(price) AS total_value FROM order_items;

question: Mennyi az átlagos rendelési érték?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT AVG(order_total) AS avg_order_value FROM (SELECT order_id, SUM(price) AS order_total FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id) t;

question: Hány különböző vásárló adott le legalább egy rendelést?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_unique_id) AS customer_count FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id;

question: Mennyi az átlagos szállítási költség rendeléstételenként?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT AVG(freight_value) AS avg_freight FROM order_items;

question: Hány rendelést adtak le 2018-ban?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders WHERE order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-01-01' AND order_purchase_timestamp < '2019-01-01';

question: Melyik 10 rendeléshez tartozott a legmagasabb értékű rendeléstétel?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT order_id, price FROM order_items ORDER BY price DESC, order_id LIMIT 10;

question: Melyek azok a termékek, amelyek ára meghaladja a 100 brazil realt?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT DISTINCT product_id FROM order_items WHERE price > 100;

question: Hány rendelés jut az egyes rendelési státuszokra?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT order_status, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders GROUP BY order_status;

question: Melyik államból érkezett a legtöbb vásárló?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT customer_state FROM customers GROUP BY customer_state ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1;

question: Melyik termékkategóriából vásároltak a legtöbb terméket?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT COALESCE(pt.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name) AS product_category, COUNT(*) AS total_items FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id LEFT JOIN product_category_name_translation pt ON p.product_category_name = pt.product_category_name GROUP BY COALESCE(pt.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name) ORDER BY total_items DESC LIMIT 1;

question: Mekkora az egyes fizetési módokkal fizetett rendelések száma?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT payment_type, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS order_count FROM order_payments GROUP BY payment_type;

question: Melyik termékkategóriából származott a legtöbb eladott termék?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT COALESCE(pt.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name) AS product_category, COUNT(*) AS total_items FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id LEFT JOIN product_category_name_translation pt ON p.product_category_name = pt.product_category_name GROUP BY COALESCE(pt.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name) ORDER BY total_items DESC LIMIT 1;

question: Melyik eladóhoz tartozik a legtöbb rendeléstétel?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT seller_id, COUNT(*) AS item_count FROM order_items GROUP BY seller_id ORDER BY item_count DESC LIMIT 1;

question: Melyik vásárló adta le a legtöbb rendelést?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT c.customer_unique_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id ORDER BY order_count DESC LIMIT 1;

question: Melyik termékkategóriának volt a legmagasabb átlagos termékára?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT COALESCE(pt.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name) AS product_category, AVG(oi.price) AS avg_price FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id LEFT JOIN product_category_name_translation pt ON p.product_category_name = pt.product_category_name GROUP BY COALESCE(pt.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name) ORDER BY avg_price DESC LIMIT 1;

question: Melyik termékkategóriához tartozik a legnagyobb összesített értékű eladás?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT COALESCE(pt.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name) AS product_category, SUM(oi.price) AS total_value FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id LEFT JOIN product_category_name_translation pt ON p.product_category_name = pt.product_category_name GROUP BY COALESCE(pt.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name) ORDER BY total_value DESC LIMIT 1;

question: Melyik vásárló költötte a legtöbbet a rendelésekben szereplő termékekre?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT c.customer_unique_id, SUM(oi.price) AS total_spent FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id ORDER BY total_spent DESC LIMIT 1;

question: Melyik eladónak volt a legmagasabb összértékű értékesítése?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT seller_id, SUM(price) AS total_value FROM order_items GROUP BY seller_id ORDER BY total_value DESC LIMIT 1;

question: Melyik államban élő vásárlók költöttek átlagosan a legtöbbet?
ground_truth_sql: WITH customer_spend AS (SELECT c.customer_unique_id, c.customer_state, SUM(oi.price) AS spend FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id, c.customer_state) SELECT customer_state, AVG(spend) AS avg_spend FROM customer_spend GROUP BY customer_state ORDER BY avg_spend DESC LIMIT 1;

question: Melyik hónapban adták le a legtöbb rendelést?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT date_trunc('month', order_purchase_timestamp) AS month, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders GROUP BY month ORDER BY order_count DESC LIMIT 1;

question: Mennyi volt az átlagos idő a rendelés leadása és a vevőnek történő kiszállítás között?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (order_delivered_customer_date - order_purchase_timestamp)) / 86400.0) AS avg_days FROM orders WHERE order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL;

question: Hány rendelést szállítottak ki a becsült szállítási dátumnál később?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS late_orders FROM orders WHERE order_delivered_customer_date > order_estimated_delivery_date;

question: Melyik évben volt a legmagasabb az összesített értékesítés?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS year, SUM(oi.price) AS total_value FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id GROUP BY year ORDER BY total_value DESC LIMIT 1;

question: Melyik az öt leggyakrabban vásárolt termékkategória?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT COALESCE(pt.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name) AS product_category, COUNT(*) AS total_items FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id LEFT JOIN product_category_name_translation pt ON p.product_category_name = pt.product_category_name GROUP BY COALESCE(pt.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name) ORDER BY total_items DESC LIMIT 5;

question: Melyik az öt eladó, amely a legtöbb rendeléstételt teljesítette?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT seller_id, COUNT(*) AS item_count FROM order_items GROUP BY seller_id ORDER BY item_count DESC LIMIT 5;

question: Melyik tíz vásárló költötte a legtöbbet?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT c.customer_unique_id, SUM(oi.price) AS total_spent FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id ORDER BY total_spent DESC, c.customer_unique_id LIMIT 10;

question: Melyek azok a vásárlók, akik az átlagos vásárlónál többet költöttek?
ground_truth_sql: WITH spend AS (SELECT c.customer_unique_id, SUM(oi.price) AS total FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id) SELECT customer_unique_id FROM spend WHERE total > (SELECT AVG(total) FROM spend);

question: Mely termékkategóriák értékesítési értéke volt magasabb az összes kategória átlagánál?
ground_truth_sql: WITH cat AS (SELECT COALESCE(pt.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name) AS category, SUM(oi.price) AS total FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id LEFT JOIN product_category_name_translation pt ON p.product_category_name = pt.product_category_name GROUP BY COALESCE(pt.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name)) SELECT category FROM cat WHERE total > (SELECT AVG(total) FROM cat);

question: Melyek azok a rendelések, amelyek értéke magasabb volt az összes rendelés átlagos értékénél?
ground_truth_sql: WITH order_total AS (SELECT order_id, SUM(price) AS total FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id) SELECT order_id FROM order_total WHERE total > (SELECT AVG(total) FROM order_total);

question: Melyik termékkategória kapta a legmagasabb átlagos értékelést?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT COALESCE(pt.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name) AS product_category, AVG(r.review_score) AS avg_score FROM order_reviews r JOIN order_items oi ON r.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id LEFT JOIN product_category_name_translation pt ON p.product_category_name = pt.product_category_name GROUP BY COALESCE(pt.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name) ORDER BY avg_score DESC LIMIT 1;

question: Melyik termékkategóriák esetében volt a legtöbb 1-es értékelés?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT COALESCE(pt.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name) AS product_category, COUNT(*) AS one_star_count FROM order_reviews r JOIN order_items oi ON r.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id LEFT JOIN product_category_name_translation pt ON p.product_category_name = pt.product_category_name WHERE r.review_score = 1 GROUP BY COALESCE(pt.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name) ORDER BY one_star_count DESC LIMIT 1;

question: Van-e kapcsolat a rendelés értéke és a kapott értékelés között?
ground_truth_sql: WITH order_total AS (SELECT order_id, SUM(price) AS total FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id) SELECT r.review_score, AVG(ot.total) AS avg_order_value FROM order_reviews r JOIN order_total ot ON r.order_id = ot.order_id GROUP BY r.review_score ORDER BY r.review_score;

question: Melyik fizetési mód esetén volt a legmagasabb az átlagos fizetési érték?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT payment_type, AVG(payment_value) AS avg_value FROM order_payments GROUP BY payment_type ORDER BY avg_value DESC LIMIT 1;

question: Hány részletben fizették átlagosan a hitelkártyás rendeléseket?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT AVG(payment_installments) AS avg_installments FROM order_payments WHERE payment_type = 'credit_card';

question: Melyik fizetési módot használták a legtöbb rendelésnél?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT payment_type FROM order_payments GROUP BY payment_type ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1;
